unit_map: Finite exact scalar and enumerated compound-unit names; original numeric expression and unit symbols remain contiguous and unchanged. No rescaling. Context guards for ambiguous symbols retained. Added fs/ps/THz/TeV/pg/mmHg/contextual ppm/ppb and exact mass-, molarity-, volume- and speed-rate unit strings.
definitions: Full-source initial-letter alignment, two-to-five-word long form; reject ambiguous/multiple explicit definitions and math-like/numeric glosses. All definitions and source hashes retained.
planner: Same catalog in greedy and joint arms. Joint beam24, up to6 insertions per connected original copied-word component. Individually zero-gain states allowed; each final component plan must lower original-word coverage, total covered words, six-gram hits and fraction. Core omits source-acronym glosses and reduced relatives.
integrity: Every original character/normalized word remains. Numeric/unit/Greek/operator/modal/negation/epistemic signatures equal. Original formula spans unbroken. Typed parenthetical single-letter unit explanations can look like functions to a generic regex and are treated explicitly as metalinguistic annotations.3% whole-summary word budget allocated before accepting edits.
quality: Independent pinned27B review of all actual final sentence/window deltas, plus adversarial controls; known automatic false positives/undercalls retained. Original970 student prompts/parser/seeds unchanged; exact-context cache only. No QA-based rewrite or selection.
limitation: Exploratory reused97 benchmark. Added definitions and function words change literal strings, not underlying conceptual authorship. No claim of independent semantic paraphrasing or guaranteed human equivalence.
definition_revision: Single PDF line breaks are not definition boundaries; forward/reverse explicit definitions; internal-letter alignment >=3 acronym letters and >=2 word-initial matches handles DNA/RNA. A fixed terminology alias is considered only if its full term occurs in the same paper and no explicit conflicting/ambiguous definition exists. Provenance kind saved for every inventory entry. Hyphenated initialisms align after removing only the initialism hyphen. A fixed list of regular singular/plural head noun variants is consolidated; genuinely distinct definitions remain ambiguous. A shorter source-attested form is preferred.
selection_note: General extensions motivated by saved copy-overlap evidence and prior meaning flags, not MCQ gold or new QA scores. Frozen protocol before submission. Reused exploratory 97-paper cohort; all previous outputs retained.
compound_revision: Recognize mol%,wt%,vol%,at% as whole percent units; do not split unit from percent sign. Protect other slash/dot/product/exponent/per compounds and adjacent unit factors. This fixes actual v1 meaning-audit failures, not QA-based selection. Held pending job while updating, refrozen before execution.
unit_revision: Add percent glyph, chemically contextual molarity, rotation-context rpm and daltons. No blind interpretation of M as molar, of % as a code/modulo operator or of rpm without rotation/centrifugation context.54 potential target positions identified in pre-existing copy-audit evidence; no new QA gold used. All v1/v2 results remain.
annotation_placement: Explanations may follow a complete protected quantity expression, including a numeric percentage parenthesis. Within prose parentheses, square explanatory brackets avoid nested parentheses. Original formula/code/quote spans never interrupted. Already present adjacent gloss is not repeated.
v4_revision: Expand quantity annotations and tightly bounded grammatical patterns. Fixed original-word denominator and strict original coverage/hit reduction remain mandatory. Earlier v1-v3 artifacts unchanged; no selection by new MCQ outcomes.
v5_revision: Protect source-defined multiword terminology and a finite technical noun-phrase list before any insertion; regions of interest remains contiguous. NFKC-normalized source definitions and duplicate-gloss detection. Mixed-case/hyphen/plural initialisms with constrained case-aware internal-letter alignment. Extended source-grounded reference aliases; an explicit conflict still blocks a reference alias. Expanded concrete method gerunds and purpose verbs. Added provenance relatives for fixed head nouns, explicit numeric reference labels, and repeated existing auxiliary/infinitive markers only in bare parallel coordinations.
measurement_revision_v5: Exact additional symbols include Å, context-checked Jy/mJy/current/energy/force/length units, spaced percentage units and enumerated inverse-unit spellings. Scientific notation and guarded numeric ranges stay literally unchanged; range glosses use plural names. Compact K/m/Å need positive physical cues. No unit conversion.
terminology_protection: Normalized full expansions from the current paper plus fixed technical terms such as regions of interest, degrees of freedom, confidence interval, standard error and false discovery rate cannot be split by insertions. All original numeric/formula/quote/code span restrictions also apply.
